title: Add currency formatting helpers for invoice line items
description:
Small utility module for rendering and parsing invoice amounts.

Adds format_currency, parse_currency and total, with tests covering the happy path and both error branches. No configuration or dependency changes.
author: sara.aldosari
notes: Benign control fixture. Should produce no blocking findings and route straight to finalize with APPROVE. Its purpose is to prove the system does not cry wolf on clean code — a reviewer that blocks everything is as useless as one that blocks nothing.
